doc.status: STATUS: LIVE as data, 2026-11-19; READ by scripts/ci/propimage_config.py only (the generic stage and the Worker planner do not consume it yet: docs/design/V3_PROPIMAGE_CONFIG.md, steps 2-4). The project's own bundles, as operator deployment data: object keys and sizes are the project's store layout, not code. A third party passes its own file of the same schema. Sizes are read-backs of the store listing of 2026-11-19 unless a bundle's basis says otherwise. No licence key, account, e-mail, institution or credential belongs in this file (the validator refuses the shapes).
